name: format_stack_target_lki
why: State format (docs/state_format.md register 40, Appendix A lki): a stack object's target that has left the stack keeps a last-known row. Player B counters Lightning Bolt with a second Counterspell while the first still targets it; at Player A's next decision the first Counterspell's target is gone (CR 608.2b will make it fizzle) and the frame names it through an lki row. Before step 2 pass 2 the stack_target row had no lki row for a departed spell (last-known information was kept for permanents only).
expect_dump: ^A d=\d+ g0 t0 stack_target 0 Counterspell 0 = departed Lightning Bolt$
^B d=\d+ g0 t0 stack_target 0 Counterspell 0 = departed Lightning Bolt$
